title: Orders between two amounts, by filter
persona: Owner who wants to look at orders between two amounts now and then. From a real request sent by the owner's own AI (6 Oct).
opening: Add a price range filter to orders so I can see orders between two amounts.

facts.the range: Any lowest and highest I type

success: the orders can be filtered by a lowest and a highest order total
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a new field on every order holding a price bracket that a rule fills in
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
